_comment: The demo corpus, shared by every build. The browser demo fetches this and seeds a database client-side; `cargo run -p inlaysql-wasm --example edge_fixture` compiles the same rows into the .inlay file the edge worker ships. One corpus, so the three demos cannot drift apart.
